script.problem: A quote isn't the BSB's exact words.

terra.problem: The leaders ask about His authority to do 'these things.' The explanation narrows their question to His right to teach.
The explanation narrows the leaders' question to Jesus' right to teach, though they ask about His authority to do 'these things.'
Jerusalem is not named in this passage. The statement that they are there needs a reference.
The passage says the leaders fear the people, but does not say the crowd is standing right there.
The text says the leaders deliberated, not that they argued. Also, 'We do not know' is four words, not three.
The leaders' answer does not end the exchange. Jesus replies to them.
The explanation is flat and repetitive, restating three times that the leaders only said they did not know.
The story says the son went; it does not say whether anyone else did the work for him.
The words 'But he did not go' are not the very next words after the son's answer. The text first says 'he said.'
The text does not say the tax collectors and prostitutes seemed furthest away from the kingdom.
The passage says the leaders saw that the tax collectors and prostitutes believed John. It does not say they witnessed a change in them.
